repos_data.description: The accessibility layer for AI coding agents. 23 MCP tools + 5 prompts for WCAG 2.2: static and rendered audits, contrast over images, form errors, keyboard traps, evidence packs a human can sign. Zero deps at the core, es/en. The machine finds, the human signs.
MCP server for wcagc — let Claude or ChatGPT run real axe-core accessibility scans (WCAG, EN 301 549, PDF/UA) through your own account.
